##### Project general facts

Elle Residences by ANAX Developments is a premium waterfront collection created in partnership with the international lifestyle media brand ELLE, whose editorial aesthetic shapes every architectural detail. Sculpted forms and panoramic glass facades define the building, which rises from a ground floor and a two-level podium to ten residential floors. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with exclusive three- and four-bedroom townhouses, many with expansive terraces overlooking the marina and the open horizon.

Wellness and leisure facilities cover every part of daily life. Residents can unwind in the sauna, the shared jacuzzi and on the outdoor yoga deck, or stay active in the indoor and outdoor gyms and along the jogging track. A swimming pool with a pool deck, a barbecue area, a mini golf course, an outdoor cinema and children's play areas add variety for families, while the Sky Lounge with its roof bar creates an elegant social setting. Concierge, valet parking and round-the-clock security complete the offer.

Interiors combine elegance, energy and style, with Parisian-inspired detailing, bespoke wooden flooring, textured wallpapers and curated tones that evoke the exclusivity of a private club with the warmth of a welcoming home. Floor-to-ceiling glazing turns everyday moments into a visual stage with views of the marina and the skyline. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fully equipped kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront master community of five man-made islands off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods, resorts, marinas and long stretches of public beach. Landscaped promenades, parks and cycling paths run along the shoreline, while hotels such as the Centara Mirage Beach Resort, beach clubs and waterfront dining venues give the islands a relaxed resort character close to the historic heart of the city.

Dubai Islands Beach, the Centara Mirage Beach Resort and the Waterfront Market are a short drive from home, along with Al Hamriya Port and Dubai Hospital. The Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with Deira, Bur Dubai and the city centre, while Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families nearby.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Branded residences linked to a globally recognised lifestyle name are in limited supply and attract design-conscious end users and investors alike. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport support strong demand for premium rentals and holiday homes, underpinning long-term value for owners.
